Keep frozen technical baseline `host_godot_boot` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

task_specification.objective: Advance release convergence by repairing automatic attack audio causality, stabilizing authored-cemetery traversal/collision/camera presentation while preserving native composition, and hardening deterministic dense-run profiling for host-native qualification.

diagnosis.root_cause: The candidate retains the native authored cemetery and weapon/audio sources, but integration is incomplete: automatic lantern attack events do not reach the mixed Effects/Master output, shipped-camera visibility is still occluded by authored geometry during traversal, and dense-run qualification lacks a native-renderer-ready evidence path.

stop_conditions: Do not replace, split, hide, or surgically modify the preserved authored cemetery package or retained component weapon/audio sources.
Stop candidate work at the three bounded repair families; GameLoop Runtime and Tester own runtime recapture, formal verdicts, and issue closure.
Do not expand into deferred backlog gaps or unrelated systems.

strategy.rationale: Use materially different root-cause treatments from prior transform tuning: repair the product-owned audio adapter and bus ownership, isolate landmark/camera occlusion through transform-space collision and selective presentation bindings around the intact map, and make dense profiling renderer-agnostic and recapture-ready without changing ordinary balance.

code: Run Godot parse/static checks and focused tests for audio routing/lifecycle, cemetery collision and camera bindings, upgrade-draft focus/value predicates, and dense-profile receipts.
Verify preserved authored-map and component hierarchies remain intact and no imported source asset was modified or replaced.
Exercise release-build guards to confirm tester-only dense actions are unavailable in exported gameplay.
runtime: GameLoop Runtime recaptures SEMI, quick AUTO, release, and lifecycle-reset audio with mixed Effects/Master waveform and source-event timelines.

GameLoop Runtime recaptures spawn, critical-route, central-building/landmark, perimeter, and ordinary-movement replay states; Tester judges collision, visibility, disappearance/occlusion, external depth, and complete-run behavior.

GameLoop Runtime runs the deterministic dense profile at native 1920x1080 when available, captures renderer status, distributions, pooled counts, runtime errors, and three reset cycles, then reruns host_godot_boot and native_godot_project preservation checks.
visual: Tester compares same-framing shipped-camera screenshots for spawn, route, landmark/cardinal, and perimeter views against the bound cemetery composition target, checking readable player/enemy silhouettes, escape lanes, warm-versus-cool lighting, external depth, and no authored-ground occlusion.

Tester inspects upgrade cards for silhouette/icon hierarchy, truthful current-to-new deltas, restrained copy, and complete keyboard/mouse/gamepad focus states; audio and dense profiling remain evidence-led rather than HUD additions.

done_when: One SEMI lantern click and one quick AUTO tap each produce exactly one bounded, recognizable attack transient in the actual mixed Effects/Master output, with distinct onset and impact source events.

Attack ownership, bus routing, release/reset teardown, and miss/concrete-hit/metal/character stems are inspectable; sustained AUTO begins only after cadence-valid continuation and stops on release and lifecycle reset.
Retained lantern onset/impact recordings and component bindings remain intact, and no long ringing impact masks or duplicates the attack report.
tasks.instructions: Repair the product-owned automatic lantern attack integration at the audio director/weapon adapter boundary. Trace the authoritative attack transaction through onset, hit resolution, impact selection, and Effects/Master playback; correct bus assignment, voice lifecycle, and bounded envelopes so one click or quick tap yields one audible semantic report. Keep onset, miss, concrete-hit, metal-hit, and character-hit cues separate, preserve existing source files and component audio, and add candidate-owned event receipts sufficient for the host audio causality probe.
tasks.title: Restore automatic attack audio causality and bounded mix

done_when: The intact authored cemetery remains one native instance with native streets/navigation, while the playable area has a larger traversable scale and a coherent external world/external depth beyond the perimeter.
The central building/landmark remains visible from spawn, critical route, and cardinal views; aligned collision prevents pass-through at the landmark and perimeter boundary.
Ordinary movement/movement replay around every side of the landmark shows no disappearance or occlusion of the player or relevant landmark, no visible void, and no proxy-floor substitution.

Level-up choices retain an authored visual hierarchy: weapon/upgrade silhouettes, compact icons, truthful current-to-new values for no more than three decision-relevant deltas, no NEW/LOCKED placeholders in CURRENT values, and distinct keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus states.
tasks.instructions: Repair spatial integration around the preserved cemetery package using an outer datum and binding/isolation fixes rather than another camera transform retune. Rebase spawn, objective, navigation, collision, and camera-coverage bindings to native authored streets; ensure the central building and perimeter boundary have transform-aligned collision and selective occlusion handling that never hard-hides the landmark.
